$comment: Ratchet floors for the dual-engine parity-corpus coverage (#1247). Derived by `node formal/parity/coverage/report.mjs --nano … --zeebe … --update` (floors only rise; lowering needs --allow-lower and review). nano = engine-core LLVM code regions while engine-core/tests/parity_corpus.rs replays the corpus (deterministic; seeded from the CI x86_64-linux measurement — region counts are platform-dependent, so seed/raise it from the CI job, not a local macOS run). zeebe = zeebe/engine JaCoCo branches on a live Camunda 8; floorPercent is the measured value (12.61% on the daily main run); slackPercent is applied once at --check (effective floor = floorPercent − slackPercent) and absorbs residual broker-scheduling variance tracked in #1679 (observed swing 12.61% → 12.45%).
